handbook.title: Newton-style prism control study
handbook.overview: A dimensioned modern first-prism illustration with computed Snell-law ray paths for three stipulated indices.
handbook.goal: Understand how a declared prism geometry and chosen refractive indices redirect rays, while keeping a modern calculation separate from Newton’s full historical inference.
signalSteps: An aperture restricts the illustrated incident ray bundle.
The stipulated refractive index and interface angle determine the calculated ray direction.
A screen records a calculated ray location for each selected wavelength.
A second-prism and incidence control would be separate steps in a future physical study.
